{{Quote|Encrypted transmission from Jom Irimore, Rebel Alliance cell member in Tyrena to Teslo Ten'doora at the base. Sir, I have a new contact. Another member of the Imperial Military (a high-ranking one, I might add) is going to supply us with information. I'll send someone to bring him to you as soon as possible. I trust in this officer's defection. Apparently, his entire family was on Alderaan.|[[Jom Irimore]], to Teslo Ten'Doora|<ref name="P14.1">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=734|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.1 - March 24, 2005}}</ref>}}
'''Teslo Ten'Doora''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he operated out of the [[Hidden Rebel Base|hidden Rebel base]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:BIttRB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Teslo Ten'Doora was contacted by [[Jom Irimore]], a Rebel officer stationed in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], about an [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] officer who was willing to defect to the Rebellion. The Imperial officer was eager to defect and give sensitive information to the Rebels because he had lost his family during the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]].<ref name="P14.1" /> Jom Irimore thus recruited a Rebel operative to escort the Imperial defector to Teslo Ten'Doora at the Hidden Rebel Base. However, the defector eventually changed the plans and requested the Rebel operative to deliver a codephrase to Ten'Doora: "Droids need Star Destroyers in the evening." The operative delivered successfully the correct codephrase and was commended by Ten'Doora.<ref name="SWG:BIttRB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateRebelOfficerQuestGiver.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Teslo Ten'Doora.]]
Teslo Ten'Doora was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BIttRB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Teslo Ten'Doora was added to the game with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Update Notes: March 24, 2005|Publish 14.1]], on [[March 24]], [[2005]].<ref name="P14.1" />

Since Teslo Ten'Doora spawned under the generic "rebel_officer_questgiver" template, his appearance was randomized under one of six possible depictions and would fluctuate after each server reset.<ref name="SWG:BIttRB" />
